sources.title: Surah At-Tawbah 9:34 (Quran.com)
sources.supports: Confirms the Quranic warning against hoarding gold and silver without spending in the way of Allah, used for context only.

sources.title: Sahih al-Bukhari 1447
sources.supports: Hadith: no zakat on less than five awaq of silver; the narration equates five awaq with 200 dirhams and gives 20 dinars for gold. Hadith text verified against the open hadith-api dataset mirroring the Sunnah.com collection; Sunnah.com itself returned a Cloudflare 403 to automated retrieval.

sources.title: Sunan Abu Dawud 1573
sources.supports: Hadith: 200 dirhams after a year, five dirhams payable; gold nothing until 20 dinars, half a dinar after a year. Hadith text verified against the open hadith-api dataset mirroring the Sunnah.com collection; Sunnah.com itself returned a Cloudflare 403 to automated retrieval.

sources.title: Zakat.org: Everything you need to know about zakat
sources.supports: States the nisab as the value of 87.48 grams of gold or 612.36 grams of silver, held over a year.

review.notes: Read all four sources from retrieved files. Sunnah.com was blocked by Cloudflare so hadith text was checked in the open hadith-api dataset instead; text matches. IslamQA is not an approved domain and Islamic Relief pages were blocked, so gram figures come from Zakat.org. No present-day currency amount is stated; the example is labelled illustrative.

claim_checks.claim: No zakat on less than five awaq of silver, equal to 200 dirhams, with 20 dinars for gold
claim_checks.explanation: The retrieved hadith states five awaq equal 200 dirhams and gives 20 dinars for gold.

claim_checks.claim: Five dirhams per 200 dirhams and half a dinar per 20 dinars after a year, which is 2.5 percent
claim_checks.explanation: The retrieved narration gives both amounts and the one year condition; five of 200 and half of 20 are each 2.5 percent.

claim_checks.claim: Zakat.org states nisab as 87.48 grams of gold or 612.36 grams of silver
claim_checks.explanation: The retrieved page states exactly these two gram weights.

claim_checks.claim: The Quran warns against hoarding gold and silver without spending in Allah's way
claim_checks.explanation: The retrieved page for 9:34 contains the verse about those who hoard gold and silver.
